description: Coherent trusted pull-request context for public API and CLI tests. Files are arrays of physical lines with exact terminators; each patch was authored from these snapshots (`diff`: base 1-5 to head 1-6; `advancedDiff`: base 1-5 to advanced 1-7). `advanced` is a later author-branch commit: when the pull request has advanced, the current diff ends at it while the review stays pinned to the reviewed commit, which must never be silently replaced.
